snippet.title: Looking Glass Wars: House of Cards | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Looking Glass Wars: House of Cards is coming to Steam. Wishlist Now.

Beat Wonderland at its own game. Master 140+ handcrafted quests in a strategic single-player deckbuilder set in Wonderland at war. Build your House of Cards to unlock powers, control when they appear, and shape the odds in your favor.

Wishlist on Steam: https://bit.ly/498qGrR
